posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Anthropic wants to do for physical hardware what its Model Context Protocol did for software The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 5h ago • Anthropic launched Model Hardware Standard to give AI agents unified interface to physical devices like robots and lab instruments. • Integration time for hardware dropped from weeks to hours in early tests. • Claude sometimes failed to understand physical cause-and-effect relationships, requiring human oversight.
